name: mlp-9-63-exact
author: claude-routine
description: Two hidden layers (9, 63) trained from scratch with Adam (cosine LR, 2000 epochs; 99.90% on all 70k), then fine-tuned from that checkpoint for 1,080 epochs with 9x extra loss weight on misclassified images until all 70k MNIST images are classified correctly. 8,335 parameters, below the 8,355 of mnist/mlp-9-64.
